title: Government (Federal)
tagline: Central ministries, national ID, and e-governance
description: Official government digital services and e-governance portals. Most are form-based or require login; documented public APIs are rare. We list the canonical URLs plus a few well-known community scrapers where they responsibly fill a real gap.

resources.name: Nagarik App
resources.description: Government super-app for citizen services: NID, citizenship, license, passport status, PAN, traffic e-chalan, voter pre-registration. Built by NITC. ~1.5M+ users; 2022 World Summit Award winner.

resources.name: Office of Company Registrar
resources.description: Bulk CSV/XML downloads of company registrations 2002–2072 BS. One of the more substantive open-data offerings from a Nepali ministry.

resources.name: ECN Voter Data Scraper
resources.description: Scrapes ECN PDFs for 7 provinces, 77 districts, 753 municipalities, 6,743 wards, 10,756 polling stations. Educational/research use only.
resources.note: Respect ECN terms; don't scrape personal voter data.
